title: Cold rebuild: every quoted value
summary: Rebuild QuotedValues from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You wrote **QuotedValues** in *Greedy and lazy*. Now write it again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints,
no solution. The tests are the ones you passed the first time.
The thing to remember is not the code, it is the reason: a greedy `.*` runs to the **last** quote, so say what a
value may not contain. If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow.

steps.prompt: Warm up. What does this print?
steps.explain: The greedy `'.*'` takes `'x' b='y'` as one match. The negated class and the lazy quantifier both stop at the first closing quote.

steps.title: Rebuild QuotedValues cold
prompt: Write `List<string> QuotedValues(string line)`: every double-quoted value in `line`, without the quotes, left to
right. An empty value `""` gives an empty string. `System.Text.RegularExpressions` is already imported.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
